en: A vintage monochrome postcard showing a large historic building partly obscured by trees. The structure has a long steep tiled roof with many dormer windows and chimneys, and a more austere lower facade with rectangular windows. In front is a wall and fenced garden area, and a grassy field in the foreground. At the top of the card, printed in red Gothic-style script, are the words identifying the scene.
